source.quote: Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, we expect year-on-year revenue growth across our clients set with revenues from commercial energy clients rebounding to mid- to high single-digit growth.

While the year-over-year comparisons benefit from the impact of last year's government shutdown, we expect this year's fourth quarter revenues to show positive growth beyond the approximately $12 million in federal revenues that we lost during last year's fourth quarter shutdown.
We expect to realize further benefits from these actions and now expect our tax rate to be approximately 19% for the full year, down from our previous guide of 20.5%.
We continue to expect operating cash flow, excluding restricted cash of $135 million to $150 million for the full year.
We now expect revenue to be roughly in line with fiscal year 2025 at approximately $1.87 billion, which assumes low to mid-single-digit growth in commercial energy for the full year.
